exposure: use of synchronised inspiratory positive airway pressure (SiPAP)
cohort: Preterm very low birth weight infants admitted to the neonatal care unit (NCU) of a tertiary hospital in Limpopo Province, South Africa, from January to July 2015
finding: Hypothermia on admission was present in 35% of infants, and was associated with resuscitation in the delivery room, respiratory distress syndrome, use of SiPAP, winter season and neonatal mortality.
